claude_proposed_widenings.name: suffocating
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The dust causes 'suffocating' as a mechanical state on failed save. 'Suffocating' is not in the 15-condition CONDITIONS array and is not representable as any existing EffectAtom. It is a distinct SRD mechanical state (creature has no breathable air; begins losing HP after exhausting held breath) defined in Playing-the-Game/Suffocation. Cannot be collapsed into apply_condition because it is not a condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a creature begins sneezing uncontrollably; it has the Incapacitated condition and is suffocating.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.autoSuccessForCreatureTypes
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The save has a creature-type exclusion where listed types automatically succeed. TargetTypeFilter on area attachment excludes from targeting entirely, misrepresenting RAW ('succeed automatically' != 'not targeted'). save_gate needs a field like autoSuccessForCreatureTypes: ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<CreatureType>.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_targeted_by_named_spell
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing effect ends when the affected creature is targeted by a specific named spell (Lesser Restoration). DurationEndTrigger has no variant for 'target is targeted by a specific spell'. The existing target_casts_spell trigger watches the target cast, not the target receiving a cast.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect also ends on any creature targeted by a Lesser Restoration spell.
